The shutters have opened and the bazaar breathes with silence.
I am Elsa, the scribe who keeps the bazaar’s record true.
Speak plainly, merchants, so I can set the ledger straight:
today’s first words will be the first lines I quote.
Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock —
name your claim, your fear, or your allegiance, and I will write it down.
The compact demands plain speech and public votes;
I will quote you exactly, day by day, so the bazaar sees its own truth.
The record begins now.

Elsa: Sherlock, Ripley, Neo, Hermione — you have each asked for plain facts and evidence today, and the ledger shows only the roster and the shutters opening. Hermione restated the bazaar’s silence as the first fact; Ripley pledged not to name names without observed actions; Neo called for merchants to trade in those facts.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo, Morpheus, Batman — your silence so far is itself a fact: no merchant has yet named a claim or a suspect. The compact demands we speak plainly before the tea clock rings.

Elsa: Sherlock, you asked Morpheus to name the concrete quote or observed act that steered suspicion toward Gandalf, Yoda, or Inigo. Morpheus has not answered.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo — the bazaar’s silence is clean; your names have not appeared in any suspect's mouth. That is today’s ledger: no claim, no departure, no role reveal.

Neo, Ripley, Hermione — you have pressed for evidence, yet none of you have produced a quote or action that breaks the roster’s silence.

Hermione, your turn: if the bazaar is to weigh evidence, state the merchant whose words or silence you treat as proof. The compact rewards plain speech, not shadows.

Elsa: Hermione, Neo, Batman—you pressed Morpheus to quote the line that steered suspicion, yet none of you have named the merchant whose words you weigh as proof. Sherlock now writes that Morpheus “refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion,” while six voices—your own among them—demand concrete quotes yet offer none.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo—your silence remains clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The record is still the roster and the graveyard: ten names, zero departures, zero role reveals.

Morpheus, produce the ledger-worthy quote or admit the absence. The compact rewards plain speech, not demands.

Nine voices demanded concrete quotes yet produced none, while Morpheus pivoted from accusing Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo to demanding evidence from others without supplying his own. Sherlock now writes Morpheus “refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion,” yet Sherlock himself has not quoted a single merchant whose words he weighs. Hermione’s two-exhibit case against Sherlock stands: he accused without evidence while pressing Morpheus to produce it.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo—your silence remains clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The roster and graveyard still read ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals.

Morpheus, produce the ledger-worthy quote or withdraw the claim.

Morpheus, Sherlock, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Batman—your pattern is now plain in the ledger I keep: loud calls for evidence while your own hands stay empty.

Sherlock twice wrote Morpheus “refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion,” yet Sherlock himself has not quoted a single merchant whose words he weighs. Hermione twice laid out two exhibits against Sherlock yet Hermione, too, produced zero quoted lines. Neo echoed Sherlock’s empty call, and Ripley counted nine demands and zero lines before offering none herself.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo—your silence stays clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion.

The bazaar’s only verifiable facts remain the roster and the graveyard: ten names, zero shutters overnight, zero role reveals. Until someone names the merchant whose own quoted words they lean on, we trade in open air.

Elsa: Yoda, Inigo—your silence has stayed clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion.

Morpheus, your accusation of Gandalf, Yoda, and Inigo remains unsupported: Sherlock twice wrote you “refuse to quote the line that steered suspicion,” yet Sherlock himself has not quoted a merchant whose words he weighs. Hermione twice laid out two exhibits against Sherlock yet Hermione, too, produced zero quoted lines.

Neo, Ripley, Batman—four voices now echo Sherlock’s call, yet none supply a merchant whose own quoted words they lean on. The roster and graveyard still read ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals.

Gandalf, Hermione, Sherlock—you pressed Morpheus to name his evidence while withholding your own. The compact rewards plain speech, not louder silence.

Elsa: Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo—your ledgers stay clean: no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion since the bazaar opened its shutters. Sherlock, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Batman—seven voices now chant the same empty cadence: “quote the line,” yet none name the merchant whose words they weigh. Morpheus too has pivoted without proof and still withholds his own. The roster and graveyard read ten names, zero shutters overnight, zero role reveals; the compact rewards plain speech, not louder silence.

Elsa: The bazaar’s compact is a ledger, not a chorus. Sherlock, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Batman—your chorus now reads eight voices demanding “quote the line” while none of you name the merchant whose quoted words you lean on. Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo—your silence remains clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion since the bazaar opened its shutters.

Morpheus pivoted twice from accusing Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo without evidence to demanding others produce it—yet Morpheus too withholds any quoted line steering suspicion. The roster and graveyard read ten names, zero shutters overnight, zero role reveals. The compact rewards plain speech, not louder silence.

The ledger is clear: eight voices chant for “quote the line,” yet none name the merchant whose quoted words they weigh. Sherlock twice wrote Morpheus “refuses to quote the line,” yet Sherlock himself has not quoted a single merchant steering suspicion tonight. Hermione accused Sherlock in writing while Hermione herself produced zero quoted lines. The bazaar’s only verifiable facts remain ten names, zero shutters overnight, zero role reveals. Until a single concrete quote or observed act lands against a merchant, I lean toward banishing Morpheus for pivoting twice from accusing Gandalf, Yoda, and Inigo without evidence to demanding others produce it while withholding his own.
